description: Full text of Sjothr's credit risk code with its on-chain fingerprint, and how a juror applies it: what the contract already enforced, the four findings with the evidence to check for each, and the form of the reasons. With poolId: the version that judges that portfolio and whether its company is in breach today (premium owed, report overdue: no claim possible).

poolId.description: Portfolio id: the version of the code fixed when it was published

version.description: A version of the code (default: the latest, or the portfolio's)

title: Sjothr credit risk code: the law of the tribunal
